topic: The actor who played the title character in Forrest Gump
core_question: Which actor played the title role in the 1994 film Forrest Gump? (secondary: Who directed the 1999 science fiction film The Matrix?)
answer_summary: Accept 'Tom Hanks' — he starred as Forrest Gump in the 1994 film.; after the topic shift: Accept 'the Wachowskis' (Lana and Lilly Wachowski, credited at release as the Wachowski Brothers) — co-directors of The Matrix (1999).
